name: oldfstat
description: oldfstat is an obsolete system call that retrieves file status information for the file referred to by the file descriptor fd, using the __old_kernel_stat structure. It is an older version of fstat and may not support larger field sizes or modern features.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the file to retrieve information for

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the file status information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: fd is not a valid open file descriptor
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the structure types
